units: relative terrain tiers; independent of screen Y
projection: One tier uses a three-cell front-facing stair flight; ridge switchback includes a landing. Terrain faces, backs and side contacts must agree with the named surfaces.

surfaces.shoreNote: The eastern pond strip remains H0 beside the H-1 basin and extends north to the headland at (65.5,68.5). Permanent banks separate it from the H1 upper grove and basin after drainage; opening the woodland does not create an upper-route shortcut.

surfaces.groveNote: The cleared northern orchard and western spur groves remain H1. Permanent banks along the worksite's east side and southern basin approach retain the drainage gate; the worksite still requires its basin stair. The rocky headland remains inaccessible terrain.

surfaces.approachNote: Same-height porch from the ridge stair foot to the south-facing distributor doorway. Service water still gates the main bay; the former east entry is sealed.

surfaces.note: The drained old road enters a passage under the ridge. The former two stair flights are sealed; there is no dry upper-road bypass.

stairs.name: Orchard climb
stairs.approachNote: The three-tree grove southwest of this flight is open H0 ground. The adjoining x112..120 cliff occupies y78..80 to match the stair crest and base; its western return remains continuous.

rope.note: Crosses the break between isolated farm-height ledges; no additional terrain tier.

water: High pond floods Basin and lower stair flights; permanent river stays wet. Surface heights do not change on drainage.

outOfBoundsUplands.name: Western approach upland
outOfBoundsUplands.note: Inaccessible top; three-cell fronts and directional banks. Western overscan is render-only. Scene owns the exact footprint.

outOfBoundsUplands.name: Southern pond bluff
outOfBoundsUplands.note: Inaccessible raised land replaces a former dense thicket; no new stair, reward or route.

outOfBoundsUplands.name: Pasture grove
outOfBoundsUplands.note: Compact inaccessible wooded rise south of the orchard ridge. A clear H0 grassy passage separates the two H1 masses; the orchard stairs remain mandatory for the upper route. Scene owns the exact footprint.

authoring: Scene owns hand-painted tiles. This contract is consumed by the layout fixture; no runtime height simulation or scene regeneration.
